result.instructions: Tameion is a treasury account that pays a company's recurring bills by itself inside a limit the owner set, and can prove every payment. These tools read the account, run a pass, and prepare calls for the owner's passkey; none of them can add a payee, raise a cap or withdraw. One spends: buy_service has the service pay a seller the owner already approved, from the account's agent key and inside the contract's caps (it needs an agent key with the buy scope). Start with treasury_inbox.

tools.description: What the treasury agent did and needs for one policy: mode, caps, balance, the most it can pay out in a day, the last pass (and whether the model was unavailable), what was paid, what waits for the owner's tap with the agent's reason, the agent's own limit proposal and autopilot recommendation, the runway: how many days until the first bill the policy could not cover, and which, holdingsElsewhere: the bill wallet's USDC in Circle Gateway on other chains (not counted as the policy's), run: every waiting bill as one call the owner approves with one passkey tap (absent on older policies), refused: what the checks refused on the last pass and why (e.g. a payee Circle has frozen), runway.idleCover: the part of the balance no bill in 90 days needs (report it; never suggest where it should earn), owners {threshold, keys} and approvals waiting for more owners (PLAN 5.7), joinRequests (devices asking to become owners; an owner adds one only if its pairing code matches), and exposure: what the bill wallet holds outside dollars and what a 30% fall would cost in days of bills (PLAN 5.49). Read-only.
tools.name: treasury_inbox

tools.description: Ask the agent to check the treasury's bills now (one pass per policy per ten minutes; a recent pass answers in between). Returns the job id; poll pass_status. Moves no money by itself in Propose mode; in Autopilot the agent pays approved payees inside the contract's caps, as always.
tools.name: run_pass

tools.description: Status, progress and report of a pass (job id from run_pass or treasury_inbox.lastPass.id).
tools.name: pass_status

tools.description: Calldata for the OWNER'S PASSKEY to approve (allow=true) or revoke (allow=false) payees. This tool cannot sign: it returns the exact call and its description in words; the owner signs on the Tameion page. Approving a payee starts the contract's cooling-off; revoking is instant.
tools.name: prepare_payees

tools.description: Calldata for the owner's passkey to set the agent's limits (per-action cap, daily cap, reserve floor, in USDC). Tightening applies at once on the contract; loosening waits the delay and the owner can cancel. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_limits

tools.description: Calldata for the owner's passkey to set the autonomy level: 0 Watch (pause), 1 Propose, 2 Autopilot. Lowering applies at once; raising waits the contract's delay. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_mode

tools.description: EIP-712 data for the BILL WALLET to sign to move its USDC held in Circle Gateway on another chain (sourceDomain: 3 Arbitrum Sepolia, 6 Base Sepolia, 0 Ethereum Sepolia, 26 Arc Testnet) into the policy. Fee and expiry come from Circle's estimate; the data names the policy as the only recipient. This tool cannot sign; the owner signs on the Tameion page (or with a key file via scripts/gateway_fund.sh) and the service relays the mint.
tools.name: prepare_fund

tools.description: Calldata for the OWNER'S PASSKEY to set a standing order on the policy: payee (must already be approved), USDC amount, everyDays, optional firstDue (unix). Once set, anyone may call payDue(id) on its due date inside the caps — the agent does it on its passes, and the bill pays even if Tameion is down. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_schedule

tools.description: Calldata for the OWNER'S PASSKEY to renew (or shorten) the agent's authority to pay: renewAgent(until). days from now (default 90, at most 365) or until (unix). The inbox's agentAuthority says when it lapses; a lapsed agent proposes and pays nothing by itself. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_renew

tools.description: Tell the agent about bills it has not seen in history (payee, USDC amount, every N days, and any early-payment discount the invoice offers: discountPercent off when paid earlyDays before due — the agent takes it only when every other bill in 30 days stays covered). Only payees the policy already attests are kept — approving is the owner's act — so this cannot add a payee. Returns kept and refused bills with reasons.

discountPercent.description: early-payment discount on the invoice, at most 10

earlyDays.description: paid at least this many days before due to earn it

tools.name: import_bills

annotations.title: Buy a paid API call (spends USDC)

tools.description: Call a paid API that answers HTTP 402 (x402) and pay it from the account, inside its limits: only a seller the owner approved, never above maxUsdc, the per-payment cap or what is left of the 24-hour limit, only on Autopilot. Needs TAMEION_TOKEN with the 'buy' scope (the owner mints it with the passkey). A seller nobody approved is not paid: it comes back as needsYou and waits on the account page. Returns the service's response body and the payment (amount, seller, transaction). The reason is written down with the purchase.

maxUsdc.description: the most this one call may cost, e.g. "0.01"

reason.description: why the agent needs it; kept with the purchase

tools.name: buy_service

tools.description: Every paid-API purchase this account made over x402 (buy_service), oldest first, as receipts: url, seller (payTo), amount, network, tx, status (paid, unconfirmed, refused, needs-you) with the reason given and, for refusals, why; id — the x402 payment-identifier sent with the payment when the seller takes one, else the settlement transaction (idFrom says which); receipt — the seller's signed offer-receipt when it sent one; sha256 of the bytes the seller returned. Sellers bought from on a cadence also appear in treasury_inbox's bills with provenance "x402 receipt". Read-only.
tools.name: purchases

tools.description: Invoices vendors (or their agents) sent to this account and the owner has not answered yet (PLAN 5.60): payee, amountText, dueAt, everyDays (0 = one payment), early-payment terms, approvedPayee, frozen, and the agent's notes in words (does the amount match what this payee usually bills, is the payee approved). Accepting or paying one is the owner's tap on the account page. Read-only.
tools.name: invoices

tools.description: Bill a Tameion account as a vendor: post an invoice the PAYEE has already signed (EIP-712 Invoice(address payee,address policy,uint256 amount,uint64 dueAt,uint32 everyDays,uint16 discountBps,uint16 earlyDays,bytes32 ref,uint64 issuedAt), domain name "Tameion Invoice", version "1", chainId of the account's chain, verifyingContract = the account). This tool holds no key and signs nothing: pass the body you signed elsewhere. Nothing is paid on receipt — the account's agent checks it and the owner accepts or declines. A ref already sent is refused; twenty invoices an hour per account. amount is USDC minor units as a string ("150000" = 0.15 USDC).
tools.name: send_invoice

tools.description: Every anchored root of a policy (root, anchor transaction, time, event count, agent, anchor). With record_events an auditor recomputes a root from the events and compares it with the chain.
tools.name: records

tools.description: The events behind one anchored root (NDJSON as written before anchoring), for an audit.
tools.name: record_events

tools.description: A trader's physical book (docs/83): every deal with where its goods are (bought, in transit, in stock, in fabrication, consigned, sold), each step in words with who vouched for it (a counterparty's signature, or the owner's own unsigned entry), the lender's classes (eligible / consigned / not eligible), the exposure in grams, the offset target on Hyperliquid, the approved counterparties and the root. Needs an agent key with `read`. Read-only.
tools.name: desk

tools.description: As a trader's counterparty (supplier, carrier, vault, buyer), post a step you ALREADY signed: EIP-712 ShipmentEvent(string deal,string kind,string goods,string quantity,string usdc,string counterparty,string document,uint64 at), domain name "Tameion Desk", version "2", chainId of the desk's chain, verifyingContract = the desk's account (the policy); usdc is "" for steps that carry no price. kind: bought | shipped | arrived | to_fabrication | consigned | returned | sold. This tool holds no key and signs nothing. The desk books it only if the signature recovers to the address the trader approved under `counterparty`; a signed purchase or sale then moves the trader's offset on Hyperliquid inside the hedge engine's rules.

usdc.description: price or proceeds; only for bought / sold

tools.name: send_milestone

tools.description: Issue every open deal's lender statement at one moment, over one root and one on-chain anchor, as one file {"kits": [...], "at"}: what a lender financing the trader's whole stock checks together (scripts/verify_desk.py <file> or /lender), so one short is never claimed by two deals. Needs an agent key with `run`.
tools.name: desk_statements_all

tools.description: Stop one of the trader's approved counterparties at once: from now its signature books nothing on the desk, so it can no longer move the offset; steps it signed before stay booked. Use it when its key may be lost or its steps look wrong (a price far from the market, a step outside its role, steps out of order), and tell the owner why. It only shrinks trust, so an agent key with `run` may do it; approving the counterparty again needs the owner's passkey.

name.description: the counterparty's name on the desk, e.g. "Supplier"

tools.name: stop_counterparty

tools.description: Issue the lender's kit for one deal: a borrowing-base statement (held, eligible / consigned / not eligible, share offset, printed maximum loss, eligible value after it, who controls the offset) signed by the desk's statement key, the deal's steps disclosed against the desk's root with each counterparty's signature, and the root anchored on chain now (costs the service a little gas). A lender checks it at /lender or with scripts/verify_desk.py. Needs an agent key with `run`.
tools.name: desk_statement

tools.description: Read-only report for any address (no key, nothing sent): recurring bills found in its USDC history with evidence, 30-day liquidity, its USDC in Circle Gateway on other chains, what the agent would pay vs ask under given caps, and the max loss. Returns a job id; poll pass_status. Chains: arc-testnet, arbitrum, base, ethereum.
tools.name: watch_address

tools.description: What the treasury agent did and needs for one policy: mode, caps, balance, the most it can pay out in a day, the last pass (and whether the model was unavailable), what was paid, what waits for the owner's tap with the agent's reason, the agent's own limit proposal and autopilot recommendation, the runway: how many days until the first bill the policy could not cover, and which, holdingsElsewhere: the bill wallet's USDC in Circle Gateway on other chains (not counted as the policy's), run: every waiting bill as one call the owner approves with one passkey tap (absent on older policies), refused: what the checks refused on the last pass and why (e.g. a payee Circle has frozen), runway.idleCover: the part of the balance no bill in 90 days needs (report it; never suggest where it should earn), owners {threshold, keys} and approvals waiting for more owners (PLAN 5.7), joinRequests (devices asking to become owners; an owner adds one only if its pairing code matches), and exposure: what the bill wallet holds outside dollars and what a 30% fall would cost in days of bills (PLAN 5.49). Read-only.
tools.name: treasury_inbox

tools.description: Ask the agent to check the treasury's bills now (one pass per policy per ten minutes; a recent pass answers in between). Returns the job id; poll pass_status. Moves no money by itself in Propose mode; in Autopilot the agent pays approved payees inside the contract's caps, as always.
tools.name: run_pass

tools.description: Status, progress and report of a pass (job id from run_pass or treasury_inbox.lastPass.id).
tools.name: pass_status

tools.description: Calldata for the OWNER'S PASSKEY to approve (allow=true) or revoke (allow=false) payees. This tool cannot sign: it returns the exact call and its description in words; the owner signs on the Tameion page. Approving a payee starts the contract's cooling-off; revoking is instant.
tools.name: prepare_payees

tools.description: Calldata for the owner's passkey to set the agent's limits (per-action cap, daily cap, reserve floor, in USDC). Tightening applies at once on the contract; loosening waits the delay and the owner can cancel. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_limits

tools.description: Calldata for the owner's passkey to set the autonomy level: 0 Watch (pause), 1 Propose, 2 Autopilot. Lowering applies at once; raising waits the contract's delay. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_mode

tools.description: EIP-712 data for the BILL WALLET to sign to move its USDC held in Circle Gateway on another chain (sourceDomain: 3 Arbitrum Sepolia, 6 Base Sepolia, 0 Ethereum Sepolia, 26 Arc Testnet) into the policy. Fee and expiry come from Circle's estimate; the data names the policy as the only recipient. This tool cannot sign; the owner signs on the Tameion page (or with a key file via scripts/gateway_fund.sh) and the service relays the mint.
tools.name: prepare_fund

tools.description: Calldata for the OWNER'S PASSKEY to set a standing order on the policy: payee (must already be approved), USDC amount, everyDays, optional firstDue (unix). Once set, anyone may call payDue(id) on its due date inside the caps — the agent does it on its passes, and the bill pays even if Tameion is down. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_schedule

tools.description: Calldata for the OWNER'S PASSKEY to renew (or shorten) the agent's authority to pay: renewAgent(until). days from now (default 90, at most 365) or until (unix). The inbox's agentAuthority says when it lapses; a lapsed agent proposes and pays nothing by itself. Cannot sign.
tools.name: prepare_renew

tools.description: Tell the agent about bills it has not seen in history (payee, USDC amount, every N days, and any early-payment discount the invoice offers: discountPercent off when paid earlyDays before due — the agent takes it only when every other bill in 30 days stays covered). Only payees the policy already attests are kept — approving is the owner's act — so this cannot add a payee. Returns kept and refused bills with reasons.

discountPercent.description: early-payment discount on the invoice, at most 10

earlyDays.description: paid at least this many days before due to earn it

tools.name: import_bills

annotations.title: Buy a paid API call (spends USDC)

tools.description: Call a paid API that answers HTTP 402 (x402) and pay it from the account, inside its limits: only a seller the owner approved, never above maxUsdc, the per-payment cap or what is left of the 24-hour limit, only on Autopilot. Needs TAMEION_TOKEN with the 'buy' scope (the owner mints it with the passkey). A seller nobody approved is not paid: it comes back as needsYou and waits on the account page. Returns the service's response body and the payment (amount, seller, transaction). The reason is written down with the purchase.

maxUsdc.description: the most this one call may cost, e.g. "0.01"

reason.description: why the agent needs it; kept with the purchase

tools.name: buy_service

tools.description: Every paid-API purchase this account made over x402 (buy_service), oldest first, as receipts: url, seller (payTo), amount, network, tx, status (paid, unconfirmed, refused, needs-you) with the reason given and, for refusals, why; id — the x402 payment-identifier sent with the payment when the seller takes one, else the settlement transaction (idFrom says which); receipt — the seller's signed offer-receipt when it sent one; sha256 of the bytes the seller returned. Sellers bought from on a cadence also appear in treasury_inbox's bills with provenance "x402 receipt". Read-only.
tools.name: purchases

tools.description: Invoices vendors (or their agents) sent to this account and the owner has not answered yet (PLAN 5.60): payee, amountText, dueAt, everyDays (0 = one payment), early-payment terms, approvedPayee, frozen, and the agent's notes in words (does the amount match what this payee usually bills, is the payee approved). Accepting or paying one is the owner's tap on the account page. Read-only.
tools.name: invoices

tools.description: Bill a Tameion account as a vendor: post an invoice the PAYEE has already signed (EIP-712 Invoice(address payee,address policy,uint256 amount,uint64 dueAt,uint32 everyDays,uint16 discountBps,uint16 earlyDays,bytes32 ref,uint64 issuedAt), domain name "Tameion Invoice", version "1", chainId of the account's chain, verifyingContract = the account). This tool holds no key and signs nothing: pass the body you signed elsewhere. Nothing is paid on receipt — the account's agent checks it and the owner accepts or declines. A ref already sent is refused; twenty invoices an hour per account. amount is USDC minor units as a string ("150000" = 0.15 USDC).
tools.name: send_invoice

tools.description: Every anchored root of a policy (root, anchor transaction, time, event count, agent, anchor). With record_events an auditor recomputes a root from the events and compares it with the chain.
tools.name: records

tools.description: The events behind one anchored root (NDJSON as written before anchoring), for an audit.
tools.name: record_events

tools.description: A trader's physical book (docs/83): every deal with where its goods are (bought, in transit, in stock, in fabrication, consigned, sold), each step in words with who vouched for it (a counterparty's signature, or the owner's own unsigned entry), the lender's classes (eligible / consigned / not eligible), the exposure in grams, the offset target on Hyperliquid, the approved counterparties and the root. Needs an agent key with `read`. Read-only.
tools.name: desk

tools.description: As a trader's counterparty (supplier, carrier, vault, buyer), post a step you ALREADY signed: EIP-712 ShipmentEvent(string deal,string kind,string goods,string quantity,string usdc,string counterparty,string document,uint64 at), domain name "Tameion Desk", version "2", chainId of the desk's chain, verifyingContract = the desk's account (the policy); usdc is "" for steps that carry no price. kind: bought | shipped | arrived | to_fabrication | consigned | returned | sold. This tool holds no key and signs nothing. The desk books it only if the signature recovers to the address the trader approved under `counterparty`; a signed purchase or sale then moves the trader's offset on Hyperliquid inside the hedge engine's rules.

usdc.description: price or proceeds; only for bought / sold

tools.name: send_milestone

tools.description: Issue every open deal's lender statement at one moment, over one root and one on-chain anchor, as one file {"kits": [...], "at"}: what a lender financing the trader's whole stock checks together (scripts/verify_desk.py <file> or /lender), so one short is never claimed by two deals. Needs an agent key with `run`.
tools.name: desk_statements_all

tools.description: Stop one of the trader's approved counterparties at once: from now its signature books nothing on the desk, so it can no longer move the offset; steps it signed before stay booked. Use it when its key may be lost or its steps look wrong (a price far from the market, a step outside its role, steps out of order), and tell the owner why. It only shrinks trust, so an agent key with `run` may do it; approving the counterparty again needs the owner's passkey.

name.description: the counterparty's name on the desk, e.g. "Supplier"

tools.name: stop_counterparty

tools.description: Issue the lender's kit for one deal: a borrowing-base statement (held, eligible / consigned / not eligible, share offset, printed maximum loss, eligible value after it, who controls the offset) signed by the desk's statement key, the deal's steps disclosed against the desk's root with each counterparty's signature, and the root anchored on chain now (costs the service a little gas). A lender checks it at /lender or with scripts/verify_desk.py. Needs an agent key with `run`.
tools.name: desk_statement

tools.description: Read-only report for any address (no key, nothing sent): recurring bills found in its USDC history with evidence, 30-day liquidity, its USDC in Circle Gateway on other chains, what the agent would pay vs ask under given caps, and the max loss. Returns a job id; poll pass_status. Chains: arc-testnet, arbitrum, base, ethereum.
